title: President Trump dismissed US intelligence findings to reinstate Jensen Huang, saying on CNBC he needed to stop market losses; Trump held $12M+ of NVDA in 2025 (Peter Baker/New York Times)
summary: Peter Baker / New York Times: President Trump dismissed US intelligence findings to reinstate Jensen Huang, saying on CNBC he needed to stop market losses; Trump held $12M+ of NVDA in 2025 — President Trump's move to put Jensen Huang back at the helm of Nvidia caps his indifference to the warnings of his own intelligence agencies.
